prompt: `sealed interface S { data class A(val x: Int) : S; data class B(val y: String) : S }`. Which functions compile? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: `fun f(s: S) = when (s) { is S.A -> s.x; is S.B -> s.y.length }`
choices.why: Yes: exhaustive, and each branch smart casts.
